input.subject: Reminder: dishwasher repair – Flat 12, 78 Copperfield Walk (ref R/PM011-1)
input.body:
Dear Turner,

Following up on our email of 29 November about Flat 12, 78 Copperfield Walk, Kingshaven, ZZ3 1ZZ (ref R/PM011-1).

The tenants report that the dishwasher fills and washes but never finishes its cycle. It started recently. We would like to send a contractor to diagnose the fault. We don't have a cost yet, and we will come back to you before any repair cost is committed.

Please reply APPROVE to let us arrange a contractor visit, or DECLINE if you would prefer to handle it another way. You can also tell us if you have a preferred engineer or the dishwasher is covered by a warranty.

Kind regards,
Northbridge Lettings

input.subject: Update on your dishwasher repair – Flat 12, 78 Copperfield Walk (ref R/PM011-1)
input.body:
Hello,

Thank you for reporting the dishwasher fault at Flat 12, 78 Copperfield Walk (ref R/PM011-1). We have asked your landlord to approve a contractor visit and have sent them a reminder today. We'll update you by 5 December, or sooner if we hear back.

Meanwhile, if the dishwasher won't stop, please cancel or end the programme and switch it off at the wall. Please don't leave it running unattended. If you see any water leaking, turn the dishwasher off and let us know straight away. Any photos of the display or error lights would help the engineer.

Kind regards,
Northbridge Lettings
